scope: Synthetic test/dev evidence only; no real user material was sent to an external service.

onlineProbes.evidence: One synthetic 1024-dimensional vector was embedded, uploaded to the disposable test/dev namespace, retrieved through a tenant filter, and deleted in the test finally block.
onlineProbes.limitations: This establishes live Pinecone connectivity, tenant-filter retrieval, and cleanup only. It does not exercise source authorization or the application evidence pipeline end to end.

coverage: authorization and reauthorization failure maps to DegradedDependency
stale selection blocks before source loading
Pinecone/retrieval lane failure maps to DegradedDependency rather than InsufficientEvidence
visual/OCR provider failure maps to DegradedDependency and releases the source lease
blob hydration failure maps to DegradedDependency
resource lease lifecycle for Ready evidence
fixed source snapshot is not resolved again
unavailable server canvas never falls back to client canvas
atomic grounded canvas commit closes resources on success
retrieved evidence cannot overwrite immutable direct-source cells
denied or expired source has no readable lease
renewal cannot exceed its hard limit

probes: revoked source stops evidence preparation; restored access allows a new Ready bundle
each request carries the version resolved for its own source snapshot
synthetic vector-mapping and blob-read outages return DegradedDependency; a later new run recovers to Ready
stale canvas is rejected before the atomic save port is called
synthetic atomic-save outage returns CANVAS_COMMIT_FAILED; a later retry commits after recovery
minimalLocalIntegration.limitations: The external port adapters are deterministic local substitutes. This is the requested minimal local E9 implementation, not a claim that an external authorization, OCR, object-storage, or deployed save service was exercised.

fixtureContract.limitations: Fixture-contract results validate expected case decisions only; they are not online dependency evidence.

notExecutedOnline: real source revocation through a deployed authorization service
version pin/latest against a deployed material catalog
real OCR provider failure and recovery
deployed canvas save failure and retry/recovery

blocker.detail: The available evaluation environment contains Pinecone and LLM configuration, but no disposable deployed authorization-service endpoint, object-store/OCR test credentials, or application test endpoint. Running the remaining items as 'online' would therefore be misleading.

decision: The requested minimal local E9 is complete: five public-seam integration probes, the broader 44-test local contract suite, and the live Pinecone baseline pass. The original full online E9 remains intentionally incomplete until a disposable integrated environment is available.
